title: On the Existence of Pressure-Equilibrium-Preserving Numerical Fluxes for Supercritical Fluids
summary: In this work we propose a new existence theorem for numerical-flux functions for supercritical fluids that are pressure-equilibrium-preserving (PEP). In particular, we characterize the existence of consistent numerical-flux functions that satisfy an algebraic PEP property. Our theory links the existence of PEP schemes to geometric properties of the equation of state describing the thermodynamics of the fluid.
